title: Custom Error Trait Bounds
goal: Implement `std::error::Error` on a custom struct to allow dynamic boxing.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: Look at the return type of check. It returns a boxed dynamic Error trait object.
To convert BadHeader into Box<dyn Error> with ?, BadHeader must explicitly implement the Error trait.
explanation: impl Error for BadHeader {} satisfies the trait bound for Box<dyn Error>, allowing ? to convert BadHeader automatically via From. Re-implementing `fmt::Display` triggers E0119 because Display is already implemented. Using `fmt::Formatter` triggers E0405 because Formatter is a struct, not a trait.
